summary: Static validation of .github/workflows/android.yml bug fix (removal of cache-dependency-path=mobile/yarn.lock) plus local simulation of the workflow's yarn install + npx cap sync android steps. All 13 requested validations passed. YAML is valid (12 steps), Setup Node has no cache/cache-dependency-path attributes, Install JS deps runs `yarn install --network-timeout 300000` (no --frozen-lockfile), Capacitor sync/gradle chmod/cache/build APK/upload APK/keystore-if/build AAB/upload AAB steps present with correct params. Local simulation in /tmp/sim (mobile without yarn.lock and without node_modules) executed `yarn install` (Done in 8.01s, generated yarn.lock 72KB) and `npx cap sync android` (Sync finished in 0.12s with 2 Capacitor plugins detected) successfully. .gitignore review OK: mobile/.gitignore only ignores build outputs / keystores; root .gitignore ignores .env everywhere. Grep for secrets (APP_USR-, cdf0aaf864, JWT_SECRET, MONGO_URL) across /app/mobile and /app/.github returned no matches.
critical_code_review_comments: Workflow does not upload the release AAB only when secrets are configured — bundleRelease will still run unsigned when secrets are absent; that's intentional per YAML comments and if-no-files-found=warn handles the empty artifact case gracefully.

typescript devDependency is pinned to ^7.0.2 in mobile/package.json — TS 7 does not exist as of Jan 2026 (latest is 5.x). yarn resolved it because ^ semantics fall back, but consider pinning to ^5.6.0 to avoid future resolution surprises. Not blocking the workflow fix.
seed_data_creation: Temp copy of /app/mobile at /tmp/sim/mobile used for yarn install + cap sync simulation; can be removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GitHub Actions workflow fix verified statically + via local simulation. Real gradle assembleDebug/bundleRelease was NOT executed (requires Android SDK + Java 21, out of scope per request). If next iteration needs a full APK build test, that must be validated on GitHub Actions itself.
rca of the issue: Previous workflow declared `cache: yarn` + `cache-dependency-path: mobile/yarn.lock` in actions/setup-node@v4. When Emergent's Save-to-GitHub does not push yarn.lock, setup-node fails at cache-resolution with 'No existing directories found containing cache-dependency-path=mobile/yarn.lock'. Fix removed both cache attributes and switched `yarn install --frozen-lockfile` to `yarn install --network-timeout 300000`, making the install resilient whether or not yarn.lock is committed. Simulation without yarn.lock succeeded (yarn generated lockfile fresh in 8s, cap sync in <1s).
